grammar.summary: 本课学习表预测精确度的 may well 与 far from。

points.title: may well 表很可能
points.explanation: The forecast may well be wrong. may well = 很有道理会……，推测的强化。

examples.en: The butterfly effect means small changes may well have enormous consequences.
examples.cn: 蝴蝶效应意味着微小的变化很可能产生巨大的后果。

points.title: far from 表"远非"
points.explanation: far from being accurate = 远非准确。far from + V-ing/形容词，否定强调。
